QuestInfo.name: Path of a Mechanic
QuestInfo.0: You decide to become a member of the Resistance in order to fight for peace and freedom. Resistance members can choose from various Jobs to fit their aptitude and taste... You wonder what Jobs are available. Talk to #b#p2151004##k, the Pirate Job Instructor, who dresses up like a bear and passes out fliers, to find out more about being a Resistance Pirate.
QuestInfo.1:
The Resistance Pirates are similar to Gunslingers, but with some distinct differences. While both shoot guns, #bMechanics ride atop robots and handle machinery with ease#k! If you want to become a Mechanic, talk to #p2151004# again.

#bIf you want to become a different Job, forfeit the quest and talk to another Job Instructor.#k
QuestInfo.2: You made a job advancement as a Mechanic. Show your courage and utilize all possible methods to defeat the Black Wings!

0.0: You have been patient. I am the job instructor for the Mechanic, the secret Resistance's secret weapon. Now, before you can say anything, don't ask me to remove my mask. This is who I really am: cute and cuddly! It is the perfect way to catch the Black Wings off guard. And...don't mind the gun.
0.1: When you think of Pirates, you probably think of swashbuckling melee or gun fighters. Well, we're a little different. You see, as #bMechanics#k, our specialty is handling machines. Powerful ones.
0.2: One of those machines is a gun. So while Mechanics are #bessentially Gun Slingers#k, we've also invented and utilized #bmore advanced technology to give us an edge in battle#k.
0.3: We've modified our guns, so they shoot lasers instead of bullets. We've also invented robots that can perform various tasks. We have robots you can ride, robots you can summon to attack enemies or protect allies, you name it. One of our greatest strengths is #bthe variety of attacks#k we possess.
0.4: Some criticize us for our dependence on machines, but what does that matter? What's important is for us to fight the Black Wings. If you want to join us, I'll turn you into a Mechanic. All you have to do is hit Accept.

yes.0: You didn't accept just to appease me, did you? Mechanics are powerful, but controlling them is kind of difficult. You'll have to quickly and smoothly control several different robots at once. Do you think you can handle it?

no.0: Not good with machines, eh? Well, it takes time. It's worth it, too, I tell you. But if you're interested in a different class, go talk to #p2151001# or #p2151002# about Battle Mages and Wild Hunters.
